points.description: States that the storage volume vs elevation relationship (storage-elevation curve) of the reservoir must be known.
States that the inflow hydrograph must be known.
States that the water surface elevation vs outflow relationship (elevation-discharge/outflow curve) must be known.
States that the initial values of storage (S), inflow (I) and outflow (Q) at t=0 must be known.
points.partial_credit: Initial condition given but only some of S, I, Q named or only vaguely (e.g. 'initial conditions'): 0.25

rubric.notes: Each of the four required details is worth 0.5 marks; accept clear synonyms (e.g. elevation-capacity curve, spillway rating curve, initial reservoir level and discharge). Part marks for a detail that is stated vaguely or incompletely. Give no marks for unrelated items (e.g. rainfall, evaporation) and do not let a wrong item cancel other correct ones; round the total to the nearest whole mark if needed (0, 1 or 2).
